message:
I need a full design audit and redesign proposal for a political figure portfolio website. This is an Astro v5 + Tailwind CSS site for Hon. Henry Musasizi, Minister of State for Finance (General Duties) in Uganda and MP for Rubanda East since 2011.

Current Stack: Astro v5, Tailwind CSS v3, Decap CMS. Hosted on Netlify at henrymusasizi.ug. Dark theme with coffee brown #4B2E0A, origin gold #C8922A, forest green #2D6A2D, deep navy #1A3557, light tan #F5ECD7. Currently loads 6 font families.

Current Design Issues:
1. Dark theme with glass orbs and particles feels like a tech startup, not a government minister site
2. 6 font families loaded - needs 2-3 max
3. No cohesive CSS variable design system - colors used inconsistently
4. Hero lacks gravitas - needs official portrait, coat of arms treatment
5. About page has nav cards pointing to non-existent sections
6. All content pages use identical card pattern - no visual hierarchy
7. Contact form uses raw hex colors inline, no validation UX
8. Navbar dropdown for More feels like afterthought
9. No social proof, press mentions, or news coverage signals
10. Footer has no social links, no press kit
11. OG tags incomplete - no og:image or twitter:card
12. Same portrait photo used on every page

Target Audience: Ugandan citizens (especially Rubanda East constituents), government officials, international development partners, media.

Brand Identity: Authority without intimidation, fiscal responsibility, Ugandan pride (national colors, subtle cultural motifs), modern yet dignified, transparency.

Please give me:
1. Full design audit with specific issues
2. Design system: OKLch color palette, 2-3 fonts, spacing scale, component tokens
3. Bento-grid or appropriate layout for a statesman
4. Redesigned hero with official portrait, coat of arms, tagline hierarchy
5. Content page templates differentiating speeches, policy posts, projects, gallery
6. About page with biography, timeline, education, key roles
7. Contact form redesign
8. Mobile-first responsive approach
9. Performance and accessibility considerations

Be very specific with CSS variable names, color values, typography scale, and component descriptions. Write the response in markdown.
